title: About
content: About Vinod Ashok Thale Postdoctoral Researcher, Zhejiang University Ph.D. in Engineering Mechanics, Xi'an Jiaotong University M.Tech. in Computational Fluid Dynamics, UPES Research background I work on computational fluid dynamics, with an emphasis on multiphase flows, interfacial dynamics and fluid–structure interaction. My doctoral work at Xi’an Jiaotong University focused on the numerical modelling of air-in-liquid compound drops, including impact forces and jet formation. At Zhejiang University, my research applies CFD methods to agricultural engineering and aquaculture, including drop impact and fish hydrodynamics. My work uses Basilisk for adaptive multiphase simulations and IBAMR for immersed-boundary applications. Explore research · View software

title: Software
content: Open-Source Software Solver modules and applications for open-source CFD frameworks, available at github.com/vinodthale. Basilisk (Basilisk C): drop-impact, aerobreakup, phase-change, and thermocapillary modules, with axisymmetric and 3D post-processing tools. IBAMR (C++, SAMRAI, ConstraintIB): fish-swimming, scalar-transport, and particle-tracking applications, with Lagrangian mesh-generation and force diagnostics. Selected Repositories Impact force of an air-in-liquid compound drop on a spherical target Code Basilisk C simulation of an air-in-liquid compound drop impacting a spherical target, with tools to extract axial pressure and viscous forces from saved flow fields. Impact force of an air-in-liquid compound drop Code Paper Basilisk simulation code for the impact force of an air-in-liquid compound drop. Maximum impact force of a drop on a spherical target Code Basilisk C research code for drop impact and target-curvature studies. The repository currently documents a flat-target reference case. IBAMR research extensions and notes Code Research code, examples and notes for exploring immersed-boundary methods and applications using IBAMR. Sharp and conservative VOF cases Code Paper Basilisk implementations and cases for contact-line dynamics, based on the work of Huang and co-authors.

title: CV
content: Curriculum vitae Current appointment Postdoctoral Researcher, Zhejiang University, China College of Biosystems Engineering and Food Science Education Ph.D. in Engineering Mechanics, Xi’an Jiaotong University, China. M.Tech. in Computational Fluid Dynamics, University of Petroleum and Energy Studies, India. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, North Maharashtra University, India. Research interests Multiphase and interfacial flows; drop impact; fluid–structure interaction; immersed-boundary methods; and adaptive computational fluid dynamics. Awards and Fellowships 2018 — Chinese Government Scholarship, Xi’an Jiaotong University, China. 2017 — Junior Research Fellowship, Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Government of India. 2016 — Junior Research Fellowship, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay. 2016 — Junior Research Fellowship, Indian Institute of Technology Dhanbad. 2016 — Junior Research Fellowship, Defence Institute of Advanced Technology, Pune. Open-Source Software Solver modules and applications for open-source CFD frameworks, available at github.com/vinodthale. Basilisk (Basilisk C): drop-impact, aerobreakup, phase-change, and thermocapillary modules, with axisymmetric and 3D post-processing tools. IBAMR (C++, SAMRAI, ConstraintIB): fish-swimming, scalar-transport, and particle-tracking applications, with Lagrangian mesh-generation and force diagnostics. Technical Expertise HPC and software: Linux, MPI, SLURM, CMake; C/C++, CUDA, Fortran, Python, MATLAB, R, GNU Octave, LaTeX; restart and batch workflows. Other CFD tools: Gerris, OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent/UDFs, COMSOL Multiphysics, STAR-CCM+. Modelling and data: Physics-informed neural networks; surrogate and reduced-order models; Gnuplot, Tecplot; high-speed imaging and image processing. Engineering tools: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, FEA, LabVIEW; electrical and conductivity measurements; optical probes. Languages: English, Mandarin Chinese, Marathi, and Hindi.
